description: Comparison between 1-step rolling forecasts (weekly ground truth observed) and true recursive multi-step forecasts (zero future target leakage across the 18w/19w horizons).
leakage_audit_conclusion: A chronological split alone does not prevent future target leakage if short autoregressive lags use realized target values within the forecast horizon. In strict recursive multi-step forecasting where only predictions are rolled forward, Random Forest achieves 14.54% test WAPE and XGBoost achieves 14.94% test WAPE (representing an expected 4.9% to 5.5% WAPE degradation due to autoregressive error accumulation over 19 weeks). This confirms model robustness even under zero intermediate target feedback.
